scripts.build: bash -c 'set -e; for p in core mcp-server web-ui cli; do npm run build -w @wpstack/$p; done'
scripts.lint: bash -c 'set -e; npm run build -w @wpstack/core; for p in core cli mcp-server web-ui; do npm run lint -w @wpstack/$p; done'
scripts.test: bash -c 'set -e; for p in core cli mcp-server web-ui; do npm run test -w @wpstack/$p; done'
